tools.name: list_loan_programs
tools.description: List Quanta Finance loan programs (name, slug, summary, tagline, url). A slug returns one program with its page FAQ. Each result starts with a notice that it is an estimate, and carries the next step and the disclaimer.

tools.name: check_deal_fit
tools.description: Check a real estate investment deal against Quanta Finance's published loan terms. Returns a verdict (fits, resize, review or does_not_work), the largest loan the published terms allow, follow-up questions and the next step. A verdict needs the property's state; without one the result is needs_state
